searchText: Thanks for the detailed breakdown! Background sync on charging combined with manual root entry makes total sense from an engineering perspective to avoid bi-weekly store releases. I was looking at this primarily through the lens of formal PoS security assumptions and light client protocol theory. Thanks for clarifying how Myotis manages the practical part! I just found out that the weak subjectivity window for Gnosis chain is only 34 hours. 🙁
